title: Chess Sorceress
description: A female sorceress with purple hair and an orange cape stands on a stone path holding a glowing purple magical staff, facing a floating chessboard. A hooded spectral figure with orange magical energy stands opposite her, playing the game amid a ruined gothic courtyard with lightning in the purple sky.
prompt: A dramatic fantasy scene of a young female sorceress with purple hair in a topknot, wearing an orange and black outfit with a flowing cape, standing in a ruined gothic courtyard overgrown with flowers. She holds a large glowing purple magical staff aimed at a floating chessboard. Opposite her is a translucent hooded spectral figure made of white and orange energy. The chessboard has glowing blue and gold pieces. Lightning cracks across a stormy purple sky above stone arches and a stained glass window, with an hourglass, potion bottle, and scrolls on the ground.
